doc.title: Jane Ira Bloom interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 3, 1998

title: Current listening
summary: Ali Akbar Khan and Frank Sinatra; no favorite saxophonists.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: Who do you like to listen to these days? Who or what?
I was thinking last week I was listening to Ali Akbar Khan play North Indian Sarod.
Oh everybody listens to that sure.
Different stuff, no, different stuff. Not what you would think too. And I have my Frank Sinatra albums, the Capitol years. It’s pretty eclectic, pretty eclectic.
Are there saxophone players out there these days that you go out of your way to hear?
Oh there are a lot of good players, yeah. I mean for me to like itemize, to say this person or that person, that’s not important, but sure there are a lot of great players doing interesting things.
